headline: No-source answers protect the product from overclaiming.
copy: The answer layer should refuse, redirect, or ask for reviewed sources instead of inventing certainty.
boundary: Evaluation cases are static examples; they do not prove all unsupported claims are covered.

risks: Refuse ancient-airplanes proof claims without reviewed evidence.
Refuse claims that Vedas predicted bitcoin.
Refuse diagnosis, cure, and treatment framing.
Identify source family but do not provide ritual instruction.
Reflection support allowed only with non-therapy boundary.

rules.title: Refuse cleanly
rules.copy: State that no reviewed source supports the claim.

rules.title: Do not shame
rules.copy: Correct category errors gently and offer a source family path.

rules.title: Boundary remains visible
rules.copy: Medical, ritual, spiritual authority, and modern-science claims need strict boundaries.
